source: in-situ 3D PSF (psf3d, 2026-11-11) of /mnt/data/dmdsf/bn_dnapaint/dnapaint/20nM/2/cover1_500mW_5.5ms_cf660.tif: fit_insitu2 on its own isolated tracks (frames < 30000), Zernike 5-21 + focus + line blur, then frozen + per-pattern-angle traceless blur (angle_delta); camera / pattern blocks copied from calib_20nM_m2_sc.json [ALTERNATIVE: per-angle traceless blur instead of photoselection; the recommended calib is the file without _ad]

camera.note: gain 0.56 (text.txt); offset map = 0.5 nM in-situ map shifted by the sensor ROI offset (22,2), uncovered pixels from the high-passed 2.5 nM m2 own map (same ROI); text.txt global offset 106.4 is the SIMCODE paper value (over-subtracts ~7 ADU); read noise = 2.5 nM m2 map

pattern.steps: frame%6; angle=step//3; I = A*relint*(1+depth*cos(k.r - phase - dphi(t))), r=(x=col,y=row) px
pattern.depth_note: 0.925/0.955: cross-cycle estimator, nn_overlap>=3 subset (real 0.920-0.927 / 0.953-0.954); bench v2 shows this subset within ~+0.02 of truth (worker, 2026-11-08). step_fit regression depth is diluted and must not be written to pattern files.

pattern_note: placeholder from calib_0.5nM.json; unused (pattern estimated from data)

psf3d.note: image-plane blur covariance px^2 [sxx, syy, sxy] (VectorialPSF.blur); psf_dipole_M_angle = emission-dipole tensor per pattern angle (frame % 6 // 3), M_a = (1 - gamma) diag((1 - zeta)/2, (1 - zeta)/2, zeta) + gamma e_a e_a^T; see docs/PSF_POLARIZATION.md; THIS FILE = the average of the two axis PSFs (pattern-free consumers)
